info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: API for Schedules & Alerts in Zoho Analytics — covering creation, management, and triggering of email schedules, and the full lifecycle of data alerts on a view.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

alerts.description: One entry per alert in the workspace. Always present; [] when the workspace has no alerts. Alerts on every supported view type (Chart / Pivot / Summary) are included.

id.description: Alert id, numeric but serialised as a string. This is the <alert-id> for the six alert-id-addressed APIs and for the alertIds arrays.

name.description: Alert name, as set by alertName.

viewId.description: Id of the view the alert watches. Fixed for the life of the alert.

enabled.description: true when the alert is live, false when it is paused. Native JSON boolean. Toggled by Change Alert Status.

createdTime.description: Creation time as an ISO-8601 offset timestamp (2026-03-12T10:15:22+05:30), rendered in the caller's profile time zone - not in the alert's scheduleDetails.timeZone.

createdByName.description: Display name of the user who created the alert.

createdBy.description: E-mail address of that user, resolved from the owner ZUID. Empty string when the lookup fails - enrichment failures never break this response.

lastModifiedTime.description: Last modification time, same format as createdTime.

lastModifiedByName.description: Display name of the user who last modified the alert.

lastModifiedBy.description: E-mail address of that user, same fallback as createdBy.

lastAlertSentTime.description: When a notification was last sent. Empty string when the alert has never notified anyone.

lastRunTime.description: When the alert was last evaluated, whether or not it notified. Empty string when it has never run.

lastRunStatus.description: Outcome of that last evaluation as a localised label - "Condition met" or "Condition unmet". Empty string when the alert has never run. Do not switch on this value; use status from Get Alert Events, which is a stable enum.

nextScheduleTime.description: Next scheduled evaluation, same format as createdTime. Empty string when the alert is paused or has no active schedule.

summary.description: "Get alerts in view" for this API.

alerts.description: Restricted to the alerts of the requested <view-id>, so every entry carries the same viewId and viewName. Always present; [] when that view has no alerts.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

summary.description: "Get view metadata for alert" for this API.

viewType.description: View type token - AnalysisView, Pivot or SummaryView. These are the internal type names, not the UI labels ("Chart View", "Pivot View", "Summary View"). Any other type is refused with 8245 before this response is built.

viewColumns.description: One entry per column of the view that can take part in an alert. Always present.

anomalies.description: Anomaly definitions configured on the view. Always present; [] when the view has none, in which case anomaly alerts cannot be created on it.

allowedAnomalyOperators.description: Operators legal for an anomaly rule on this view - a view-level property, not a per-column one. Derived from the X axis: a YEAR bucket yields the yearly tokens, ABSMONTH the monthly ones, DATE / TIMESTAMP the full day-level set. ["sinceLastAlert"] when the view has anomalies but no date-bucketed X axis; [] when anomalies is empty. Always present.

viewColumnIndex.description: The positional index identifying this column in a write request (rules[].viewColumnIndex, rowAxis, columnAxis, and values[0] for type: "column"). The only column identifier the Alert APIs accept - see The viewColumnIndex Contract.

axis.description: Axis the column occupies in the view - X, Y, and so on.

axisType.description: Axis role - XAXIS, YAXIS, COLOR, TOOLTIP, …

axisDisplayName.description: Display name of the column as the report shows it. Use this for a user-facing column picker.

operation.description: Aggregation or date bucket applied to the column - SUM, GROUP, YEAR, ABSQUARTER, ABSMONTH, ABSWEEK, DATE, TIMESTAMP, MEACATEGORY, GEO, … It is what decides the date-bucket operators and, for the view's X axis, the contents of allowedAnomalyOperators.

dataType.description: The column's original data type - PLAIN, NUMBER, DATE, TIMESTAMP, … Informative only: the operator catalogue is computed server-side from fields that are not all exposed here, so never derive operators from dataType yourself.

viewId.description: Id of the view (or of the underlying table, for a base-layer column) the column belongs to.

formulaId.description: Id of the backing formula when the column is a formula column; empty string otherwise.

geoRole.description: Geo role of the column. Conditional - present only for geo columns. Role 1 (geometry) narrows allowedOperators to isn / notisn.

thresholds.description: Chart threshold display names configured on this column, sorted by their internal property order (T1, T2, …). [] when the column has none. A value from this array is what a type: "threshold" rule puts in values[0]. An empty array is also the reason threshold is absent from allowedRuleTypes.

allowedOperators.description: Every rules[].operator token legal for this column, already narrowed by its data type, aggregation and geo role. Treat it as the authoritative allow-list - an operator outside it fails with 8119. Token meanings: Appendix E.

allowedRuleTypes.description: Which rules[].type values this column supports: constant always; column only when the view has at least two NUMBER columns and this column is one of them; threshold only when thresholds is non-empty. A type outside this list fails with 8119.

viewColumnIndex.description: The column the anomaly is defined on. Conditional - omitted when the underlying column reference cannot be resolved to an index.

anomalyName.description: The name to send as rules[].anomaly.name. Must match exactly, otherwise 32000042.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

summaryType.description: data, subTotal or grandTotal. Always present. An anomaly alert reports data.

isAnomaly.description: true when the alert's rules are anomaly rules. Always present. Read-only - it is derived from rules[], and a value sent on write is ignored.

rowAxis.description: viewColumnIndex of the row axis of a Pivot / Summary alert. Conditional - omitted when the alert has no row axis, and also omitted when the stored column no longer exists in the view.

columnAxis.description: viewColumnIndex of the column axis, same conditions as rowAxis.

conditionExpression.description: The boolean expression combining the rules, e.g. "(1 AND 2)". Always present; "" when the stored value is null. It is emitted verbatim from storage, so an alert created outside the V2 API can carry an expression that references more rules than exist - validate it against rules.length before posting back.

notifyOnChange.description: true when the alert notifies only on a state change. Always present.

scheduleDetails.description: The schedule, normalised into write shape: array-valued weekDays / monthDays / months, an explicit 1-based interval, and skipWeekends present only for hourly and daily. Always present, but {} for an alert with no stored schedule.

email.description: E-mail channel. Conditional - present only when configured. Within it, emailIds and groupIds are themselves omitted when empty, and attachmentType is omitted when no report is attached.

slack.description: Slack channel - url, messageType, plus subject / message or payload. Conditional.

msteams.description: Microsoft Teams channel, same shape as slack. Conditional.

webhook.description: Webhook channel - url, method, body, params, headers. Conditional. params and headers are omitted when empty.

workflows.description: Zoho Flow workflows mapped to this alert. Conditional - omitted when none are mapped.

actionsByFlow.description: Zoho Flow actions mapped to this alert. Conditional - omitted when none are mapped.

rules.description: The alert's rules in rules[] shape. Always present. Column references come back as viewColumnIndex, threshold references as display names ("T1"), and date values re-normalised to yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Anomaly rules carry an anomaly object and no viewColumnIndex.

data.description: The alert configuration. It does not repeat the alert id - you already supplied it in the URL.

id.description: Workflow id. This is the only field Update Alert reads back.

name.description: Workflow name; "" when the workflow has none. Display only - it is not validated on write.

enabled.description: true when the workflow is active. Display only.

actionConfigId.description: Flow action configuration id. A genuine JSON number, unlike every other id in this family - and Update Alert requires it back as a string, so this one field does not round-trip unedited.

connectionId.description: Id of the connection the action uses. Also a JSON number, with the same conversion caveat.

AlertScheduleDetails.title: AlertScheduleDetails
AlertScheduleDetails.description: How often the alert is evaluated. See scheduleDetails Fields.

calendarFrequency.description: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly. Case-insensitive on input, normalised to lower case. Any other value is 8119. See calendarFrequency Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: Every N hours, around the clock.
Every N days at a fixed time.
Every N weeks on the selected weekDays.
Every N months, on a date or an Nth weekday.
Every N years, in the selected months.

interval.description: "Repeat every N units of calendarFrequency". Permitted values depend on the frequency: hourly → 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12; daily → 1-7; weekly → 1-4; monthly → 1-12; yearly → 1-5. Out of range is 8119.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone id used to evaluate the schedule - Asia/Kolkata, America/New_York, Europe/London, UTC. An unrecognised id, or an explicit null / empty string, is 32000045.

hour.description: Hour of day, 0-23. Out of range is 8119. Not applicable to hourly (32000052).

minute.description: Minute of hour. Must be a multiple of 5 in the range 0-55; 9 is 8119. Not applicable to hourly.

skipWeekends.description: Skip the evaluations that fall on weekend days. You do not choose the days - they are the weekend of the schedule time zone's locale (Sunday for Asia/Kolkata; Saturday and Sunday for America/New_York and UTC; Friday and Saturday for Asia/Riyadh). Applicable only to hourly and daily (32000052 elsewhere).

weekDays.description: Days of the week, 1 = Sunday … 7 = Saturday. More than one may be selected ([2, 4] = Monday and Wednesday); a single day is still a one-entry array ([6]). Duplicates are dropped. Applicable only to weekly.

monthDays.description: Dates of the month, 1-31, or the single-entry list [99] meaning "last day of the month" (99 cannot be combined with other dates). For monthly several dates may be selected ([1, 15]); for yearly the array must carry exactly one entry, because a yearly schedule stores one date per selected month. One of monthDays or (weekOfMonth + dayOfWeek) is mandatory for monthly and yearly - see below.

weekOfMonth.description: Which occurrence of dayOfWeek within the month: 1 = first … 4 = fourth, 5 = last. Used together with dayOfWeek. Applicable only to monthly and yearly.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for the "Nth weekday" form, 1 = Sunday … 7 = Saturday. weekOfMonth: 2, dayOfWeek: 3 reads "the second Tuesday of the month". Used together with weekOfMonth.

months.description: Months in which the alert runs, 1 = January … 12 = December. More than one may be selected ([1, 7]). Applicable only to yearly.

AlertEmail.title: AlertEmail
AlertEmail.description: E-mail notification channel. See email Fields.

subject.description: E-mail subject line. A blank value is 32000012.

message.description: E-mail body. HTML is permitted and filtered through AntiSamy. When systemMailId is true a stricter filter that strips all HTML is applied instead.

notifyAdmins.description: Include the workspace admins / DB Owner in the recipient list.

emailIds.description: Explicit recipient addresses. Maximum 25 entries - the request template permits 1,000, but the server refuses more than 25 with 32000007. Blank entries are skipped.

groupIds.description: Workspace group ids whose members receive the e-mail, as numeric strings. 1-1000 entries.

includeReport.description: Attach or inline the report itself. When true, attachmentType becomes mandatory (8079).

attachmentType.description: inline or attachment. Any other value is 8119. Ignored when includeReport is false. See attachmentType Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: The report is rendered inside the e-mail body.
The report is sent as a file attachment.

attachFilteredDataset.description: Also attach the dataset filtered to the rows that matched the alert criteria. Independent of includeReport - it may be set on its own.

systemMailId.description: true sends from the Zoho Analytics system mail id; false sends from the alert creator's address. Organisation-level display-e-mail settings can override this.

AlertNotification.title: AlertNotification
AlertNotification.description: In-product (WMS) notification channel. See notification Fields.

notifyAdmins.description: Notify the workspace admins / DB Owner.

notifySharedUsers.description: Notify every user the view is shared with.

subject.description: Notification title. A blank value is 32000012.

message.description: Notification body. HTML is filtered through AntiSamy.

AlertWebhook.title: AlertWebhook
AlertWebhook.description: Generic HTTPS webhook channel. See webhook Fields.

url.description: Target URL. Must start with https:// - anything else is 32000025.

method.description: HTTP method used to invoke the webhook. See method Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: Invoke the webhook with an HTTP GET.
Invoke the webhook with an HTTP POST. The default.
Invoke the webhook with an HTTP PUT.
Invoke the webhook with an HTTP PATCH.
Invoke the webhook with an HTTP DELETE.

body.description: Raw request body sent with the call. Not parsed or validated.

params.description: Query / form parameters appended to the request, 0-10 entries. See params and headers Fields.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers sent with the request, 0-10 entries. Same entry shape as params. See params and headers Fields.

AlertAnomaly.title: AlertAnomaly
AlertAnomaly.description: Turns the rule into an anomaly rule. When any rule carries it, every rule must (32000017), and the alert must be on a Chart view (32000019). See anomaly Fields.

name.description: Name of an anomaly definition configured on the view, taken verbatim from anomalies[].anomalyName of Get View Metadata For Alert. An unknown name is 32000042. This is also what resolves the rule's column, which is why viewColumnIndex must be absent.

value.description: The operator's argument, when the chosen anomaly operator takes one (for example the N of lastNMonths).

comboType.description: How matched anomalies are aggregated: top or all. See comboType Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: Consider only the N most significant anomalies.

comboTypeValue.description: The number of top anomalies to consider, as a numeric string. Must parse to a positive integer, otherwise 32000021.

AlertRules.title: AlertRules
AlertRules.description: The evaluation rules. 1-10 entries - more is 32000018, none is 32000006. See rules Fields.

operator.description: The comparison. It must appear in the column's allowedOperators from Get View Metadata For Alert - anything else is 8119. Full catalogue in Appendix E.

viewColumnIndex.description: The column the rule tests, as a viewColumnIndex string. Must be omitted on anomaly rules (32000046); the column is resolved from anomaly.name instead. An index that does not resolve is 32000041.

type.description: What the column is compared against: constant, column or threshold. It must appear in the column's allowedRuleTypes (8119 otherwise). See type Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: Compare the column against a literal value.
Compare the column against another NUMBER column of the same view.
Compare the column against a chart threshold (T1, T2, …).

values.description: The comparison value(s), always strings, 1-300 entries. How many are required depends on the operator and the column - see the value-shape table below. Supplying values for a no-value operator is 32000047.

CreateAlertConfig.title: CreateAlertConfig
CreateAlertConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

alertName.description: Display name of the alert. Must be unique within the view (32000011 otherwise) and non-blank (32000005). It can be changed later through Update Alert.

summaryType.description: Which slice of the report the rules are evaluated against. Mandatory when the view is a Pivot Table - omitting it there is 8079. For Chart and Summary views it defaults to data. See summaryType Values.
x-zenesis-enums-desc: Evaluate the rules against the report's data rows.
Evaluate against the single grand-total row.

rowAxis.description: viewColumnIndex of the row-axis column of a Pivot / Summary report. Mandatory when summaryType is subTotal on a Pivot or Summary view (32000044 otherwise); meaningless and ignorable elsewhere. Must resolve to a column of this view (32000041 / 32000029). Send it as a string.

columnAxis.description: viewColumnIndex of the column-axis column of a Pivot / Summary report. Same validation as rowAxis, but never mandatory.

conditionExpression.description: Boolean expression combining the rules by their 1-based position in rules[]. Allowed tokens are rule numbers, AND, OR, ( and ) - e.g. "(1 AND 2) OR 3". Mandatory when rules has more than one entry (8079 otherwise); with a single rule it defaults to (1). The grammar is validated strictly: unbalanced parentheses or a dangling operator is 32000024, a reference outside 1..rules.length is 32000020, a blank value is 32000015.

notifyOnChange.description: When true, a notification is sent only when the alert's state changes (the condition turning true after having been false) rather than on every matching evaluation.

isAnomaly.description: Accepted but ignored. The server derives it from whether rules[] carries anomaly objects and overwrites whatever you send. It is returned by Get Alert Configuration so that response can be posted back unchanged.

slack.description: Slack incoming-webhook channel. See slack and msteams Fields.

msteams.description: Microsoft Teams incoming-webhook channel. Identical shape to slack.

workflows.description: Rejected by this API with 32000049. Zoho Flow workflow mappings can only be re-asserted through Update Alert, because the mapping cannot exist before the alert does.

actionsByFlow.description: Rejected by this API with 32000049, for the same reason as workflows.

rules.description: The evaluation rules. 1-10 entries - more is 32000018, none is 32000006. See rules Fields.

validateSystemTags.description: When true (the default) and the alert attaches the report to an e-mail, the view's Data Warning system tags are checked and creation is refused with 8241 if a restricted tag is present. Set it to false to create the alert anyway. It has no effect when no report is attached.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

alertId.description: Id of the alert just created, numeric but serialised as a string. This is the <alert-id> for Get Alert Configuration, Update Alert, Change Alert Status, Run Alert, Get Alert Events, and the alertIds array of Delete Alerts.

AlertWorkflows.title: AlertWorkflows
AlertWorkflows.description: Accepted only here. Re-asserts the Zoho Flow workflow mappings that already exist on this alert. Every id must already be mapped to this alert, otherwise 32000043 naming all offending ids at once. See workflows Fields.

id.description: Workflow id, exactly as returned by workflows[].id of Get Alert Configuration for the same alert. Digits only, up to 20 characters. An id not already mapped to this alert fails with 32000043.

AlertActionsByFlow.title: AlertActionsByFlow
AlertActionsByFlow.description: Accepted only here. Re-asserts the Zoho Flow action mappings that already exist on this alert. Every actionConfigId must already be mapped to this alert, otherwise 32000050. See actionsByFlow Fields.

actionConfigId.description: Flow action configuration id. Must already be mapped to this alert (32000050). Send it as a JSON string, even though Get Alert Configuration returns it as a number - see the note below.

actionConfigName.description: Flow action name, up to 50 characters. Read when the mapping row has to be re-created.

connectionId.description: Id of the connection the action uses, also as a JSON string. Read when the mapping row has to be re-created.

UpdateAlertConfig.title: UpdateAlertConfig
UpdateAlertConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

alertName.description: As in Create Alert. Uniqueness is still enforced within the view, excluding this alert itself.

summaryType.description: As in Create Alert. Still mandatory when the alert's view is a Pivot Table. See summaryType Values.

rowAxis.description: As in Create Alert. Mandatory when summaryType is subTotal on a Pivot / Summary view.

conditionExpression.description: As in Create Alert. Mandatory when rules has more than one entry.

notifyOnChange.description: As in Create Alert. Omitting it resets the alert to false.

isAnomaly.description: Accepted but ignored; derived from rules.

scheduleDetails.description: As in Create Alert, parsed as a complete period definition - never merged field-by-field with the stored one. See scheduleDetails Fields.

email.description: See email Fields. Omitting it removes the e-mail channel.

notification.description: See notification Fields. Omitting it removes the in-app channel.

slack.description: See slack and msteams Fields. Omitting it removes the channel.

msteams.description: Same shape as slack. Omitting it removes the channel.

webhook.description: See webhook Fields. Omitting it removes the channel.

workflows.description: Accepted only here. Re-asserts the Zoho Flow workflow mappings that already exist on this alert. Every id must already be mapped to this alert, otherwise 32000043 naming all offending ids at once. See workflows Fields.

actionsByFlow.description: Accepted only here. Re-asserts the Zoho Flow action mappings that already exist on this alert. Every actionConfigId must already be mapped to this alert, otherwise 32000050. See actionsByFlow Fields.

rules.description: As in Create Alert, 1-10 entries. See rules Fields.

validateSystemTags.description: As in Create Alert - the Data Warning gate applies to updates too.

DeleteAlertsConfig.title: DeleteAlertsConfig
DeleteAlertsConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

alertIds.description: Alert ids to delete, as numeric strings - a bare numeric literal fails. 0-1000 entries; an empty array is accepted and deletes nothing. Every id must belong to <workspace-id> (7319) and must still exist (32000009), and the caller must be permitted to act on each one (7301).

ChangeAlertStatusConfig.title: ChangeAlertStatusConfig
ChangeAlertStatusConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

alertIds.description: Alert ids whose status changes, as numeric strings. 0-1000 entries; an empty array is accepted and changes nothing. Every id must belong to <workspace-id> and must still exist.

enabled.description: The state applied to every id in alertIds: true makes the alert live, false pauses it. There is no per-id state - to enable some and pause others, send two requests.

RunAlertConfig.title: RunAlertConfig
RunAlertConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

validateSystemTags.description: When true (the default) and the alert has an e-mail attachment configured, the view's Data Warning system tags are checked and the run is refused with 8241 (HTTP 409) if a restricted tag is present. Set it to false to run anyway. It has no effect on an alert with no e-mail attachment.

GetAlertEventsConfig.title: GetAlertEventsConfig
GetAlertEventsConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower bound, as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss or yyyy-MM-dd (the time then defaults to 00:00:00.000). Interpreted in the caller's profile time zone. A malformed value is 32000028.

toDate.description: Inclusive upper bound, same formats. A date-only value defaults the time to 23:59:59.999. Must be greater than or equal to fromDate, otherwise 8119.

status.description: Outcome filter, 1-3 distinct entries drawn from triggered, notTriggered and error. Duplicates collapse silently. An unknown value, or a non-string entry, is 8119. See Alert Event Statuses.

recordsPerPage.description: Page size, 1-100. A larger value is silently clamped to 100 - compare pageDetails.recordsPerPage against what you asked for.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

alertEvents.description: One entry per evaluation inside the requested window, oldest first (ascending alertTime). Always present; [] when nothing matched - still HTTP 200.

pageDetails.description: Pagination block. Always present - this API always paginates, even when the caller sends no pagination attributes.

alertTime.description: When the evaluation happened, as epoch milliseconds in a string ("1779226560981") - deliberately unformatted so the caller can render it in its own locale and time zone. Conditional: omitted on the rare feed row with no stored timestamp.

status.description: Outcome as a stable enum: triggered, notTriggered or error. Always present. Unlike lastRunStatus of the listing APIs this value is not localised and is safe to switch on. Any unrecognised stored code is reported as notTriggered.

message.description: Description of the failure. Conditional - present only when a message was recorded, which in practice means status is error.

errorCode.description: Symbolic error name of the failure, e.g. INCOMPATIBLE_DATE_VALUE. Conditional - present only when status is error. Note it is a name, not one of the numeric codes used by the Error Codes tables.

pageNo.description: The page that was served, 1-based. Native JSON number.

recordsPerPage.description: The effective page size, already clamped to the 100-record maximum. Compare it against what you requested.

hasNextPage.description: true when more records match the filters. Re-issue with pageNo + 1; do not infer the end of the data from a short page.
